title: Dragon of Dreams
description: A colossal black dragon with iridescent scales and glowing golden eyes coils through a glowing pond in a fantastical night landscape. A cloaked witch with a lantern stands atop its back while two children in fantasy attire interact with luminous mushrooms and water at the pond's edge, and a young girl in a pink tutu and crown dances on a candy-covered shore.
prompt: A massive black dragon with shimmering multicolored scales and glowing golden eyes winds through a glowing pond under a starry purple night sky with shooting stars. A witch in a black cloak holding a purple lantern stands on the dragon's back. Two children in fantasy cloaks kneel by the luminous water near giant glowing mushrooms while a little girl in a pink tutu, red cape, and crown dances joyfully on a shore made of giant candies and sweets, whimsical storybook fantasy style.
